name: Technology
grading_rules: Grade the claim as stated. Documented = dates, inventions, people and adoption the evidence states plainly. Debated = contested priority disputes (who invented X first), disputed impact, or estimates. Legend = popular inventor myths the evidence contradicts (lone-genius stories, apocryphal quotes). Interpretation = narrator's framing or predictions. Unsupported = no card says it. Treat company marketing claims as claims, not facts.
